title: Security Risk
name: securityrisk
ps: OS-aware server hardening audit for Debian/Ubuntu, RHEL/Rocky/Alma, SUSE and Alpine: shell timeout, passwordless sudo, SSH, file permissions, empty passwords, firewall, fail2ban, SELinux/AppArmor and panel SSL. Every fix is backed up, validated and rollback-safe.
author: mdestafadilah
